plan.title: Beginner Full Body Functional Fitness
plan.description: A simple 3-day full-body routine balancing pushing, pulling, and squatting patterns for overall health, functional mobility, and daily activity preparedness.

workouts.title: Full Body Foundations A
workouts.description: Focuses on the core barbell squat, horizontal pushing, and vertical pulling.

workouts.title: Full Body Foundations B
workouts.description: Focuses on the hinge pattern, vertical pushing, horizontal pulling, and unilateral leg mobility.

workouts.title: Full Body Foundations C
workouts.description: Reinforces leg strength through pressing, bodyweight pushing, posture correction, and lower back stability.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.description: The king of lower body exercises for quads and glutes.
exercises.instruction: 1. Place bar on upper back. 2. Squat down until thighs are parallel to floor. 3. Drive through heels to stand up.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: The standard compound movement for developing chest mass and upper body pushing power.
exercises.instruction: 1. Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar. 2. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders. 3. Lower the bar to mid-chest. 4. Press back up until arms are locked.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A vertical pulling exercise for developing back width (Lats).
exercises.instruction: 1. Grip bar wider than shoulders. 2. Pull bar down to upper chest while arching back slightly. 3. Slowly return bar to top.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: A core isometric exercise that strengthens the abdominals and stabilizers.
exercises.instruction: 1. Start in a push-up position. 2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. 3. Hold the position, keeping abs tight.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A hinge movement focusing on hamstrings and glutes.
exercises.instruction: 1. Hold barbell at hip height. 2. Push hips back while lowering bar down legs. 3. Feel stretch in hamstrings and return to start.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: A vertical press focusing on the anterior and lateral deltoids.
exercises.instruction: 1. Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height. 2. Press the weights upward until arms are straight. 3. Lower slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: A horizontal pull focusing on the rhomboids and middle back.
exercises.instruction: 1. Sit with feet on pads, knees slightly bent. 2. Pull handle toward abdomen. 3. Squeeze shoulder blades together. 4. Extend arms back.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.description: Unilateral exercise for balance and leg development.
exercises.instruction: 1. Step forward and lower back knee toward ground. 2. Push up and step forward with the other leg.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Machine-based movement for high volume leg growth.
exercises.instruction: 1. Sit in machine with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Lower platform toward chest. 3. Press back up without locking knees.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.description: A bodyweight push-up variation that emphasizes the triceps and inner chest.
exercises.instruction: 1. Form a diamond shape with hands under chest. 2. Lower body until chest nearly touches hands. 3. Push back to start.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Targets the rear delts and improves shoulder health/posture.
exercises.instruction: 1. Set cable to eye level with rope. 2. Pull toward forehead, pulling rope ends apart. 3. Squeeze back of shoulders and return.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: A bodyweight exercise for the lower back and spinal erectors.
exercises.instruction: 1. Lie face down on floor. 2. Lift arms, chest, and legs simultaneously. 3. Hold for 2 seconds and lower.
